releaseNotes:
Smart Life v0.12.7 (14185)
- Work Hours day status now has only Worked and Off; Vacation is removed from the menu.
- Existing saved Vacation entries are safely treated as Off when loaded.
- Tapping Start or End opens numeric hour/minute entry directly with AM/PM; the analog clock dial is removed.
- Smart Life v0.12.6 one-tap Gmail Notes backup, Arabic RTL PDF, JSON restore copy, and local-first behavior are preserved.
